description.value: Masiero Pizzeria Napoletana is Vernon's dedicated Neapolitan pizza restaurant, baking pies in a handcrafted wood-fired oven imported directly from Naples, Italy. Situated in downtown Vernon, the 50-seat dining room (including an 8-seat bar) serves house-made antipasti and desserts alongside a curated selection of local craft beers and wines. Ingredients are sourced both locally and from premium Italian suppliers, giving the menu a farm-meets-Italy character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: phone number (778-943-2019), address (105-3301 30 Avenue, Vernon), and website URL all match. The site confirms takeout and online ordering via a dedicated Take Out page, and the menu explicitly marks multiple items with '(v)' for vegetarian. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag appears outdated relative to the hours shown on the website contact page; the OSM record may need a hours update.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed sit-down restaurant in downtown Vernon with a functioning website, online ordering, and current contact information. Clearly open and publicly accessible.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items marked '(v)' for vegetarian: Warm Smoked Olives, Focaccia, Insalata di Farro, Ricotta Piadina, Tanto Latte Burrata, Tomato Bruschetta, Gnocchi. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
